author: cnippet.dev
name: cnippet-empty
description: A composable empty-state block for when there's no data to show — no results, no events, an empty folder, cleared filters. Ships Empty plus EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia (with a stacked 'icon' variant), EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription and EmptyContent, so you can drop in an icon or illustration, a title, supporting copy and call-to-action buttons. Dependency-free (just cva + cn).
